summary: A unified library of SOTA model optimization techniques like quantization, distillation, pruning, neural architecture search, speculative decoding, etc., compressing deep learning models for downstream deployment frameworks.
usecases: Optimizing deep learning models for faster inference speed
Reducing model size without significant accuracy loss
Deploying optimized models in production environments
ideas: Develop integration tools for PyTorch and TensorFlow
Provide automated end-to-end model optimization pipelines
Enable efficient edge deployment of compressed models
